# Bundled front-end libraries

Served by the add-on itself under `static/vendor/`, so the dashboard needs no internet access for its own UI and isn't blocked by browser tracking protection.

| Library | Version | Licence | Source |
|---------|---------|---------|--------|
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (see `leaflet/LICENSE`) | https://leafletjs.com / `leaflet@1.9.4/dist` |
| Leaflet.heat | 0.2.0 | MIT (see `leaflet-heat/LICENSE`) | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.heat / `leaflet.heat@0.2.0/dist` |

Files are unmodified copies of the published `dist` builds.
